patches.description: Generative tracks: hold a track's Seq and press its Arp - Tracks 2..4 go into Flux, a melody loop that keeps changing; Track 1 (Seq + Drum) goes into Pulse, drum pulses spread evenly over each lane's steps - set with the five encoders; the track display shows FL / PU
